item.tib: phywa g.yang sgrub pa'i cha lag shog chung kha pa'i cha lag shog chung
item.coloph: phywa g.yang sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor bri ba'i cha lag shog chung 'di yang rim gyis brgyud nas/ stang chen dmu tsha gyer med kyis/ tshe dbang bde chen snying po'am/ g.yung drung thogs med rtsal du 'bod pa bdag la dngos grub tu gnang ba'o/ de nas las ldan 'ga' yis bskur ngor/ shar grol smin gling du yi ger btab pa'o/ dge des sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas pa'i rgyu gyur cig//
